name: belvoir-lighthouse-ci
description: CI-only Lighthouse runner. Kept out of the site's package.json so `npm ci` for the site and its audit stay unchanged.
//overrides: Overrides clear the high/moderate npm audit findings in @lhci/cli 0.15.1 deps (it pins lighthouse 12.6.1). Re-check each with npm audit when bumping @lhci/cli.
